The story has been changed enough to feel like a brand-new game, even if you've already finished Love Season.[/p][p]It follows a main character who, on the brink of death by a mermaid, is saved by a strange creature that now lives inside him - you, the player.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/8c328f175fc0eb77f14cd902a494d0da732c89d3.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]"You died chasing tail. You wake up in a witch’s cabin, confused, naked, and noticeably [i]enhanced[/i]. Your body’s changed. Magic is coursing through you. Was it a dream? You play as a young farmer navigating daily life, horny neighbors, chickens on the loose, ancient technology, magic, and the occasional monster invasion—all while trying to keep your pants on (or not).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/2ae737e3fcb694c415eb3fba9a4379097c876f83.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/84291a6ff5bf4c35a8e7d5694ab56cfe4d31593c.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/ac5601d5760e17d4247f08b6d0fabb9b91fba579.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/f106c0d4a8501defa97a8c7f4b03d108f0fcbdfd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/farmer-kink-0-13-130860632"]Download for free here![/url] [/h1][p][i](version 0.13)[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Love Season S2 - Ending
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/e6f016b00415016472b5c2cffebdb07595397160.png[/img]

[u][b]Chapter 10, Part 2 is out![/b][/u] This marks the end of the second season and the end of the main story of Love Season - Farmer's Dreams.

[u]Postwork fix: [/u] 
 In Chapter 10 Part 1 I went a little overboard with the postwork, especially in some characters' faces. All CGs are now fixed with their original looks.

[u]What's next?[/u]
I'm open to create new DLCs expanding the story of Love Season (like expanding the endings, showing what happened during the time skip, adding more fetishes and so on) depending on your feedback.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3083460/Love_Season__Sharing_Fantasy

Love Season - Sharing Fantasy allows you to share the love with other male characters - basically, you'll get to see the female main cast having sex with other characters besides the main character! All interactions must have the approval of the player to happen and no one will fall in love with someone else, or cheat on the main character.

notes.title: 🌍 Translation Update: Coming Soon in Multiple Languages! 🌍
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41184320/85b16482bb2781f8489dd4d10cb46e4e2a5ef5b5.png[/img]

Hello, horny gamers! We have some exciting news to share with you all. We're thrilled to announce that we are currently working on translating Love Season into multiple languages, starting with [b]Portuguese (Brazil)[/b]. But that's not all! We also have plans to add [b]French[/b], [b]Italian[/b], [b]Russian[/b], and [b]Spanish[/b] translations.

As a small team with limited resources, we'll be initially relying on machine translation for these additional languages. However, we will be slowly working on proofreading and improving these translations over time.

We would love to invite you to join us in this endeavor. If you're fluent in any of the languages we mentioned (French, Italian, Russian, or Spanish) and would like to help us refine the translations, we encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/CQUvJG5]Discord[/url] - there you'll find all the information you need to help us (and it's a pretty easy and simple process!). Together, we can make our game accessible to a broader audience and ensure that the translations are top-notch.

We deeply appreciate your support and understanding as we work diligently to enhance the gaming experience for everyone. Stay tuned for future updates and announcements regarding the translations and other exciting updates coming to the game!

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/CQUvJG5

Thank you for being a part of our amazing community! ❤

notes.title: Love Season - Winter
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5N2qi0I.png[/img]
[b]The winter has come to Love Season![/b]

This DLC adds more content to chapter 6 - enough to be considered a whole new chapter on it's own! It's 131 new CGs, 4 sex scenes and more story development. 
[u]The Winter story happens before the end of Chapter 6, just after the scene with Vivian (and Evelyn) at the pub[/u].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eO6kX4l.png[/img]

[b]Love Season - Winter[/b] is a chapter about a day in their world very similar to our Christmas, when you can exchange gifts with your friends with a twist - receiving a gift and not giving anything back can result in several years of bad luck, meaning some characters will have to improvise their gifts if they didn't prepare enough...



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910070/Love_Season__Winter/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24907/Love_Season__Winter_DLC/

notes.title: About the "Big" Update
notes.content:
Recently we released an update that made you basically download the game again. It wasn't added any new content though. We fixed a small bug when playing the Extra Scene "Extra 1 - Heather" in the Replay Room and, most importantly, changed the file structure of the game - something we had to do to make it easier to release updates and make it possible to release extra content (DLCs). The game size didn't change; we removed the old files and added new ones.

We're sorry for the inconvenience! 

[u][b]What's coming next:[/b][/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S6f4g8i.png[/img]
[b]Love Season - Winter[/b] is a DLC that adds a whole new chapter to the game (although it's not classified as a new chapter in the game as it happens during Chapter 6).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UhV4zWQ.png[/img]
More information about it soon!
